historical_record.description: Presented by M. Justin Herman of the Redevelopment Agency and National-Braemer, the developers, who were giving the land, the Recreation and Park Commission accepted in concept and in principle the plans for the Peace Pagoda and Plaza; the pagoda, designed by Yoshiro Taniguchi, was a gift from the people of Japan as a monument to peace.

The Recreation and Park Commission gave conceptual approval to a schematic design for rebuilding the Japantown Peace Plaza around a Japanese garden, with the newly formed Friends of the Japan Peace Plaza raising the money.
